def execute_command(image) -> List[ImagePatch]:
    image_patch = ImagePatch(image)
    car_patches = image_patch.find("white car")
    
    if not car_patches:
        return image_patch
    
    # Sort cars based on their horizontal center
    car_patches.sort(key=lambda p: p.horizontal_center)
    
    # Filter out cars that are not on the right side of the road
    right_side_cars = [car for car in car_patches if car.right >= image_patch.width / 2]
    
    # Further filter out cars that are not parking diagonally
    diagonal_cars = []

        if i == 0 or abs(right_side_cars[i].horizontal_center - right_side_cars[i-1].horizontal_center) > 10:
            diagonal_cars.append(right_side_cars[i])
    
    return diagonal_cars
